injuries.detail: Poehling (lower body) was placed on long-term injured reserve by the Ducks on Wednesday.
Moore (lower body) might be an option to play by the end of the week, Derek Lee of The Hockey News reports Wednesday.
Greer (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Monday.
Head coach Marco Sturm announced Saturday that Hagens (back) is expected to miss multiple weeks, per Jack Studley of Boston Hockey Now.
Danforth (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Thursday, per the NHL media site.
Grzelcyk (lower body) suffered a "flare-up" and could be out for at least "a few days," head coach Lindy Ruff told Rachel Lenzi of The Buffalo News on Tuesday.
Bahl will undergo surgery for a ruptured Achilles tendon and won't play again in the 2026-27 season, the Flames announced Sunday.
Huberdeau (hip) took the ice in a regular jersey Friday, Pat Steinberg of QR Calgary 770 AM reports.

Staal (calf) will be a game-time decision versus the Kraken on Saturday after head coach Rod Brind'Amour told reporters, "So, we'll find out probably tomorrow after you know gets through the morning, and hopefully he does play," per Tom Gul
Byram (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday.
Bichsel (lower body) is expected to miss at least two games after getting injured Thursday versus the Jets, Robert Tiffin of NHL.com reports.
Back was placed on long-term injured reserve on Saturday.
Johansson (undisclosed) will be with the Red Wings for their upcoming four-game road trip, Ansar Khan of MLive.com reports Friday.
Edvinsson (contract dispute) is on the Red Wings' injured, non-roster list, per the NHL media site Wednesday.
Regula (undisclosed) was designated for long-term injured reserve Thursday.
Savoie (lower body) was shifted to long-term injured reserve Thursday.
Andersen (knee) isn't expected back until "maybe" December, head coach Mike Babcock told NHL.com on Tuesday.
Janmark (undisclosed) does not have a timetable for his return from injury.
Head coach Paul Maurice said Friday that Marchand (knee) will travel with the Panthers during their upcoming three-game road trip, Jameson Olive of the Panthers' official site reports.
Head coach Paul Maurice said Friday that Barkov (knee) will travel with the Panthers during their upcoming three-game road trip, Jameson Olive of the Panthers' official site reports.
Gadjovich (upper body) is out indefinitely, the team announced Thursday.
Faber (skull) has told the Wild that he's ready to play and expects to return for Saturday's game against the Bruins, Michael Russo of The Athletic reports Wednesday.
Gustavsson (hip) will travel with the Wild during the team's upcoming three-game road trip, per Joe Smith of The Athletic.
Demidov (foot) skated Tuesday and could resume training with the team next week, Patrick Friolet of RDS reports.
Montembeault (lower body) is considered day-to-day, according to Renaud Lavoie of TVA Sports on Saturday.
Kovacevic (undisclosed) is undergoing imaging Thursday and won't play in the Devils' home matchup against the Capitals, Kristy Flannery of The Hockey News reports.
Mantha (throat) was placed on long-term injured reserve by the Devils on Wednesday, retroactive to Nov. 7.
Casey will be out of action for 6-8 weeks after undergoing a knee procedure, Kristy Flannery of The Hockey News reports Friday.
Barzal (knee) won't be in the lineup against the Sharks on Monday but has been upgraded to day-to-day, Andrew Gross of Newsday reports.
Durzi (undisclosed) was put on injured reserve Thursday, per Mollie Walker of the New York Post.
Shesterkin will require surgery and a lengthy rehab process to address his season-ending right knee injury, Vince Z. Mercogliano of The Athletic reports Sunday.
Veleno (lower body) was placed on long-term injured reserve Saturday, Vince Z. Mercogliano of The Athletic reports.
Foegele (knee) will miss 3-4 weeks, Jackson Starr of the Senators' official site reports Saturday.
Eklund had surgery to repair a torn ankle tendon and will be out 10-12 weeks, Bruce Garrioch of Postmedia reports Thursday.
Grebenkin (back) underwent successful surgery and is expected to miss at least four months.
Soderblom (upper body) is week-to-week, per Penguins PR on Monday.
Rust (lower body) will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Michelle Crechiolo of the Penguins' official site reports Thursday.
Graves (lower body) is out indefinitely and was placed on injured reserve Sunday.
Musty (upper body) was put on non-roster injured reserve Monday, according to Curtis Pashelka of The San Jose Mercury News.
Keyser (upper body) was placed on non-roster injured reserve by the Sharks on Monday, Curtis Pashelka of The San Jose Mercury News reports.
Melanson (chest) will be a game-time call for Saturday's clash with the Hurricanes, Tom Gulitti of NHL.com reports.
Lindgren (upper body) will be a game-time decision ahead of Saturday's matchup with Carolina, Tom Gulitti of NHL.com reports.
McCann (lower body) will be out for approximately 10 weeks, the team announced Sunday.
O'Brien (lower body) was placed on non-roster injured reserve Wednesday.
Krug (ankle) was placed on long-term injured reserve by the Blues on Monday, per PuckPedia.
Tucker had arthroscopic knee surgery and will be re-assessed in six weeks, the team announced Wednesday.
Wood (undisclosed) was transferred to long-term injured reserve Wednesday, David Alter of The Hockey News reports.
Blankenburg (undisclosed) was placed on injured reserve by the Maple Leafs on Friday, David Alter of The Hockey News reports.
Domi (back) was transferred from the non-roster list to long-term injured reserve Wednesday, per PuckPedia.
Merzlikins is expected to miss 4-6 months to begin the 2026-27 regular season while recovering from a shoulder injury, per Luke Fox of Sportsnet.
The Mammoth announced Thursday that Schmidt (upper body) is considered week-to-week, Cole Bagley of KSL Sports reports.
Chytil (shoulder) looks set to return to the lineup against the Rangers on Friday, Jeff Paterson of CanucksArmy.com reports.
Co-president of hockey operations Henrik Sedin said Monday that he hopes Demko (hip) will be ready to return before Christmas, Kevin Woodley of NHL.com reports.
Sandin (knee) will be with the Capitals for their two-game road trip, Tarik El-Bashir of Monumental Sports Network reports Monday.
Bjugstad (pectoral), Dawson Mercer, Nico Daws, Alexander Command and a pair of draft picks were traded to the Jets from the Devils on Friday in exchange for Connor Hellebuyck.
